# Godrej Verano Gurgaon (godrejverano.org)

> Information site for Godrej Verano, a residential project by Godrej Properties Limited in Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122102, India. Run by an authorised channel partner of Godrej Properties; this is not the official Godrej Properties website. Contact: +91 9211535553, aaptdubey@godrejverano.org.

## Key facts (as of October 2026)
- Developer: Godrej Properties Limited (NSE/BSE listed)
- Location: Sector 63A, off Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram
- Land: 11.36 acres (Phase 1 RERA registered area 9.65 acres)
- Towers: 4 residential towers, G+39 and G+40, 4 apartments per floor
- Homes: approx. 624
- Clubhouses: 3 (about 2 lakh sq ft total club area), 80 percent plus open area
- Configurations: 3 BHK (2,150 sq ft), 3 BHK + servant (2,575 sq ft), 4 BHK + servant (2,950 sq ft), 5 BHK + servant (3,900 sq ft), penthouses 4,500 to 6,500 sq ft. Super built up area.
- Indicative price: Rs 5.91 Cr to Rs 10.72 Cr, approx. Rs 27,490 per sq ft, excluding PLC, parking, club charges, GST
- Payment plan: 20:5 construction linked; EOI Rs 10 lakh
- HRERA registration: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/1081/813/2026/53 dated 11 August 2026
- License: 129 of 2025 dated 23 July 2025
- RERA completion date: 2033; developer indicates phased handover from 2031
- Nearby: Golf Course Extension Road 2 min, SPR 8 min, Sohna Road 10 min, Sector 55-56 Rapid Metro 10 to 15 min, NH-48 10 to 15 min, IGI Airport about 30 min
